title: Rabbi Berekhyah HaKohen Berabbi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned under this name in Bamidbar Rabbah 3:8, 13:3, 13:8, 14:4 and 16:11, and likewise several times in the Tanchuma. Hyman suggests that he is Rabbi Berekhyah bar Chiyya HaKohen.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied abbreviation במ״ר is expanded as Bamidbar Rabbah. Its Midrash Rabbah — TE digital 3:8 has Rabbi Berekhyah HaKohen bar Rabbi, supporting that expansion for the first citation. The other listed locations have not been individually checked, and Hyman’s tentative identification with Berekhyah bar Chiyya HaKohen is not adopted as a merged identity.

The checked Numbers Rabbah 3:8 and the complete named discourses at 13:3, 13:8 and 14:4, together with 16:11, positively give Berekhyah HaKohen with bar Rabbi/berabbi forms; one nearby statement in 14:4 omits berabbi. These checks add to the earlier note’s historical scope statement that other locations had not then been individually checked. The unspecific Tanchuma references and the identification with Berekhyah bar Chiyya remain Hyman’s reports or conjecture, not a new census or identity merge.
